name: overdrive-companion
description: Flutter Android companion for **Overdrive** (BYD Atto 3 and other BYD models). Talks to the **Overdrive HTTP server on the car** (default port **8080**) over LAN or a tunnel (Zrok, Cloudflare, Tailscale, WireGuard). This is **not** the head-unit app and **not** a WebView wrapper.
